ops.title: How to READ+WRITE the live Tailscale ACL and MINT auth keys from an agent session when agent-browser won't hold the login cookie — cookiesync cookies -> curl the admin console's own internal API (GET/POST /admin/api/acls; keys at /admin/api/public/tailne

ops.body:
Editing the SHARED yasyf tailnet ACL (login.tailscale.com, owner yasyfm@gmail.com, tailnet `tail71af5d.ts.net`) programmatically. **agent-browser (both Browserbase and local Clark) will NOT carry Tailscale's HttpOnly `tailcontrol` session cookie into the page context — it renders/redirects to `/login` even right after a fresh desktop login and a good cookiesync seed.** curl with the same cookie jar works fine. So drive the admin console's OWN internal API with curl, not the browser.

**Cookie source:** `COOKIESYNC_REQUESTOR="agent-browser · yasyf" cookiesync cookies "https://login.tailscale.com"` → JSON `{cookies:[{name,value,domain,...}]}`. Build `Cookie:` header from every cookie whose domain contains `tailscale`. The session cookie is `tailcontrol` (domain login.tailscale.com; its far-future expiry does NOT prove validity — a fresh login elsewhere rotates it, so test). Requires the daemon grant primed once (`cookiesync auth` in Terminal.app on an Aqua session — the agent's macOS **Background** session can't Touch-ID, see [[background-session-keychain]]). If cookiesync only reads a stale/other-tailnet Chrome:Default while the real login lives on a peer Mac's Arc/Chrome-Profile-3 (they time out "no reply within 15s"), the cookie authenticates a DIFFERENT tailnet — `GET /admin/api/self` shows `loginName`/`orgTailnetId`; `GET /admin/api/acls` shows whether the fleet tags are present.

**The API (axios base `/admin/api`, `withCredentials`):**
- READ: `GET /admin/api/acls` → `{"status":"success","data":{"acl":"<HuJSON text>","hash":"<sha256 of acl text>","warnings",...}}`. The `hash` = sha256(acl) and is the optimistic-concurrency token.
- WRITE (raw-file editor's exact call, `zc.post("/acls",{acl,hash})`): `POST /admin/api/acls` body `{"acl":"<full new HuJSON>","hash":"<hash from a fresh GET>"}`. Validates server-side (bad policy → error code, fail-closed), and `invalid_hash` if raced. `{"status":"success"}` on save. (`POST /admin/api/acls/patch {hash,patches}` is the VISUAL editor — typed ops like `add-default-ssh`; NOT for raw text.)
- **CSRF gate = Fetch-Metadata, not a token.** No `XSRF-TOKEN` cookie is ever issued. The POST MUST send `Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin` (+ `Origin`/`Referer: https://login.tailscale.com/...`) or it 400s `Forbidden: Sec-Fetch-Site header is empty`. Add `Sec-Fetch-Mode: cors`, `Sec-Fetch-Dest: empty` too.

**Safety discipline (shared tailnet — never force-replace):** GET the live text, edit as byte-precise text surgery on the HuJSON (preserve comments/trailing commas — do NOT json round-trip, it reformats), then VALIDATE by normalizing HuJSON→JSON (strip `//` outside strings — note `tailscale.com/cap/drive` has `//` inside a string — then trailing commas) and asserting ONLY the intended structural diff before POST. Re-GET the hash immediately before POST and abort if the live text != the text you built against. Stash the original for one-POST rollback.

**Auth keys via the same cookie (verified 2026-07-15):** the console FRONTEND moved to `console.tailscale.com` (old `/admin/keys` 302s there; `console.tailscale.com/admin/api/*` answers 410 "the console API is served by the control server") but the API stays on login.tailscale.com under the same axios base. Endpoints (found by grepping the console JS bundle): `GET /admin/api/public/tailnet/-/keys[?all=true&includeInvalid=true]` lists; `POST /admin/api/public/tailnet/-/keys/` (trailing slash) mints — body is public-API-v2 shape `{"capabilities":{"devices":{"create":{"reusable":false,"ephemeral":true,"preauthorized":true,"tags":[]}}},"expirySeconds":7200,"description":"…"}`; `PUT/DELETE /admin/api/public/tailnet/-/keys/<id>` update/revoke. Same `Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin` CSRF gate and tailcontrol cookie. `tags: []` gives an UNTAGGED member-owned key (OAuth clients can't — they mint tagged-only), which matters because tagged nodes may lack autogroup:internet grants post-2026-07-13 tightening. `cookiesync cookies <url> --format netscape` emits a curl `-b` jar directly. Used for the exit-node probe harness (see cc-notes note a7299659).

Applied 2026-07-13: scoped the allow-all `acls` rule `src ["*"]→["autogroup:member"]`, added `hosts.yasyf-home=100.88.252.58`, appended the 4 fleet grants from `tailnet/policy.hujson`; gcp/zo/sprite left default-deny. Rollback copy: `~/.yclaw/acl-rollback-2026-07-13/original-policy.hujson` (sha `0f67d3a7…`).

Applied 2026-07-14: appended a `nodeAttrs` entry granting the host node the full-URL capability `https://tailscale.com/cap/debug-disable-bind-conn-to-interface` — hosted control ACCEPTS raw `https://tailscale.com/cap/...` strings in nodeAttrs and delivers them in SelfNode.CapMap within seconds (no support ticket needed). The live shared policy ALREADY had a nodeAttrs section (mullvad ×3, funnel, drive) — merge additively inside the existing array, never add a second section. Rollback: `~/.yclaw/acl-rollback-2026-07-14-nodeattrs/`. The cookiesync daemon grant may need a fresh `cookiesync auth` (user-run, Aqua session) and its first `cookies` call can take >60s cold. See [[host-serving-migration-2026-07]], [[security-hardening-2026-06]].
